title: Keto Turkey Pilaf Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious keto pilaf bowl made with savory turkey, aromatic spices, and silky pilaf. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Season the turkey breast with salt, pepper, and aromatic spice blend.
Heat 1 tablespoon of silky olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the turkey breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer it to the oven.
Roast the turkey in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of silky olive oil in a separate skillet over medium heat.
Add the Mediterranean pilaf to the skillet and toast it for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Once the turkey is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the sliced turkey on top of the toasted pilaf.
Finish with additional aromatic spice blend and silky olive oil to taste.
